advisories.message: The upstream client executable is named naive. Preserve its config.json path or listen/proxy flags. A Naive server implemented through Caddy uses the caddy profile instead.
Review descriptor compatibility of the installed Chromium-based build before accepting a higher soft limit. Proxy credentials and certificate trust remain application configuration.
The 65536 descriptor pair is a suggestion only. Accept it only after verifying the build supports high descriptors; otherwise retain inherited limits.

The existing on-failure restart policy and delay remain in effect unless explicitly changed. Finite commands need --restart no; long-running modes still need application health and capacity monitoring.
Basename matching does not authenticate the executable, version or build. Preserve the original arguments, working directory and explicit user choices.
